items.q: What are the usual turnaround times?
items.a: It depends on the formula. Plan 2 weeks for a pet portrait, 3 weeks for a custom illustration, and 4 to 6 weeks for a book cover. I give you a precise turnaround in the quote.
A 30% deposit is required to lock in the project. The balance is due upon delivery of the final file. Payment by bank transfer or Stripe.
Yes, every formula includes a number of revisions. Beyond that, additional revisions are billed at the hourly rate (€40/h).
You get a personal, non-exclusive usage right. For commercial use (published book, derivative product), an additional rights transfer is needed — I include it in the quote if needed.
Yes, I work with clients all over the world. All communication is by email, and delivery is digital.

items.q: Do you do illustrations on other themes (adults, pro events)?
items.a: My world is children's book illustration, but I'm open to other projects if the spirit speaks to me. Feel free to reach out.
